summary: Guardforce AI filed a Form 6-K attaching a notice and proxy for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held October 27, 2026, in Hong Kong and via Zoom. The sole substantive resolution is a capital reorganization: a 40-for-1 share consolidation from $0.12 to $4.80 par value, a capital reduction to $0.001 par, and a subsequent subdivision into 4,800 new shares per consolidated share. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private or activist event is present; this is a routine EG M notice, not a special situation.
